claims.sourceText: Memorandum for the Director of Central Intelligence, 'Successful Application of Narco-Hypnotic Interrogation (ARTICHOKE)', CIA Security Office, July 1952, National Security Archive John Marks Collection Box 6, https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/sites/default/files/documents/1952-07-14%20JM%20Box%206%20F13%20Artichoke-ocr.pdf
claims.text: By July 1952 the Security Office was reporting operational use to the Director: '(a) Subjects were Russian agents suspected of being doubled. (b) Cover was psychiatric-medical. (c) Control methods were by narcosis, by hypnosis, and by combination of both.' The attachment records one interrogation held for about an hour and forty minutes 'with a subsequent total amnesia produced by post-hypnotic suggestion'.

title: Memorandum for the Director of Central Intelligence, 'Successful Application of Narco-Hypnotic Interrogation (ARTICHOKE)', July 1952
